summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Electrovaya Inc., a foreign private issuer, announcing the timing of its Q2-2026 financial results release and conference call. The filing is purely a routine earnings schedule notice with no special-situation elements such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or management change. The registrant is acting solely as the issuer providing an operational update. No deal terms, strategic review, or corporate action are disclosed. This is a standard current report of foreign issuer results timing and does not qualify as a special situation.
